skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Gleaming Fey
skins.content: Pudding's winter attire for going out/Gleaming Fey. The snowflake-embroidered gauze lining mitigates the heaviness of the jacket, giving it a light, pretty touch.
skins.quote: Pudding is responsible for emergency power maintenance today. Overtime pay is always appreciated—all the better when nothing happens—allowing her to wait under the tree and hand out gifts to passing children.
